answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch every identity is one marble in a public jar; five are drawn for audit by five unrelated peers. A peer that rubber-stamps a fake leaves a plume of smoke in the public log: its own bond is slashed and its audit rights are revoked for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds of 40 POA, 4,000 POA in all, while honest agents keep the nectar of full rewards and pay only one bond.
